title: Interior Designer & 3D Visualizer
description:
3D Visualizer \& Interior Designer

**Experience:** 1\-3 Years  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Industry:** Interior Design / Architecture  
**Location:** Delhi NCR

Job Overview

We are looking for a talented and creative **3D Visualizer \& Interior Designer** with **2–5 years of professional experience** to join our team. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of interior design, space planning, materials, lighting, and 3D visualization, along with the ability to transform design concepts into high\-quality, realistic visual presentations.

The candidate will be responsible for developing interior design concepts, creating detailed 3D models and renders, preparing presentations, and coordinating with the design team to deliver projects as per the required design standards.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop creative and functional **interior design concepts** for residential and commercial projects.
* Prepare **2D layouts, furniture plans, elevations, and detailed drawings**.
* Create high\-quality **3D models, realistic renders, and interior walkthroughs**.
* Develop realistic materials, textures, lighting, furniture, and décor elements in 3D.
* Understand client requirements and translate concepts into visually appealing design solutions.
* Prepare mood boards, material boards, and design presentations.
* Coordinate with senior designers, architects, vendors, and other team members.
* Make design revisions based on client and project requirements.
* Ensure accuracy and consistency in drawings, 3D models, and presentations.
* Stay updated with the latest **interior design trends, materials, furniture, lighting, and visualization techniques**.
* Manage multiple projects and meet deadlines effectively.

Required Skills \& Software

* Strong knowledge of **Interior Design principles and space planning**.
* Excellent 3D visualization and rendering skills.
* Proficiency in **3ds Max, AutoCAD, and V\-Ray/Corona**.
* Knowledge of **SketchUp, Photoshop, Lumion, Enscape, or other visualization software** will be an added advantage.
* Good understanding of materials, textures, lighting, furniture, and interior detailing.
* Ability to create realistic and aesthetically appealing renders.
* Good design sense and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage deadlines.

Experience \& Qualifications

* **1\-3 years of relevant professional experience** in Interior Design and 3D Visualization.
* Bachelor's/Diploma in **Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field** preferred.
* Candidates must have a strong **portfolio of interior design and 3D visualization work**.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is **creative, detail\-oriented, technically strong, and passionate about interior design**. The ideal candidate should be able to take a design concept from the initial idea through 3D visualization and presentation while maintaining high standards of quality.

**If you are passionate about creating beautiful spaces and bringing interior concepts to life through 3D visualization, we would love to hear from you.**

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

title: Product Designer
description:
### **About the role**



We are looking for a Junior Product Designer to join our Product team and help shape the everyday experience of Globalli's platform — from onboarding flows to the dashboards our customers rely on to manage a global workforce. You will work closely with product, engineering, and operations stakeholders to turn real user problems into clear, usable interfaces.



This is a great fit for someone early in their design career who thinks in systems, sweats the details, and wants mentorship and ownership in equal measure. We care more about the strength of your portfolio and your design thinking than your exact years of experience.



You will report directly to our Head of Product.


### **What you'll do**


* Design user flows, wireframes, and high\-fidelity UI for new and existing product features, from early concept through shipped experience
* Contribute to and help maintain our design system in Figma, keeping components and patterns consistent as the product grows
* Partner with product managers and engineers throughout the product development cycle — from requirements through implementation and QA
* Conduct lightweight user research and usability checks, and incorporate feedback into iterative design improvements
* Prepare polished, developer\-ready designs and specs, and stay engaged during implementation to protect design quality
* Help translate complex workflows (like multi\-entity onboarding or payroll operations) into interfaces that feel simple

### **What we're looking for**


* A strong portfolio demonstrating product/UX design thinking — process, not just polish
* Proficiency in Figma (prototyping, components, and design systems)
* Solid understanding of user\-centered design principles, information architecture, and interaction design fundamentals
* Clear communication skills — you can explain your design decisions and take feedback well
* Comfort working async and independently as part of a distributed, remote\-first team
* Curiosity about B2B/SaaS products, payroll, HR tech, or workforce management is a plus, but not required


**We welcome applicants at any stage of their design career — recent graduates, bootcamp grads, and self\-taught designers with a compelling portfolio are all encouraged to apply.**

title: Web Development Intern
description:
Web Developer InternJob Overview

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic **Web Developer Intern** to join our team. The intern will work on real\-world web development projects and assist in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining responsive and user\-friendly websites and web applications.

Key Roles \& Responsibilities

* Assist in developing and maintaining websites and web applications.
* Write clean, structured, and maintainable code using **HTML, CSS, and JavaScript**.
* Assist with frontend development using frameworks such as **React.js** or similar technologies.
* Work on responsive website layouts compatible with desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Assist in integrating APIs and backend services into web applications.
* Debug, test, and resolve website and application issues.
* Work with **Git and GitHub** for code management and version control.
* Assist in deploying websites using platforms such as **Vercel, Netlify, or similar services**.
* Collaborate with designers, developers, digital marketing team members, and project managers.
* Optimize websites for performance, usability, and basic SEO requirements.
* Learn and use modern development tools, AI\-assisted coding tools, and development resources.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, documentation, and project discussions.
* Stay updated with current web development technologies and best practices.
* Perform other web development tasks assigned by the senior developer or project manager.

Required Skills

* Basic knowledge of **HTML, CSS, and JavaScript**.
* Understanding of responsive web design.
* Basic knowledge of Git and GitHub.
* Familiarity with React.js or another frontend framework is an advantage.
* Basic understanding of APIs and web development concepts.
* Good problem\-solving and logical\-thinking skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and development tools.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.

Preferred Skills

* React.js / Next.js
* Node.js / Express.js
* MongoDB or other databases
* REST APIs
* GitHub
* Vercel / Netlify
* Basic UI/UX understanding
* Familiarity with Generative AI development tools

Learning Opportunities

The intern will gain practical exposure to:

* Real\-world website and web application development
* Frontend and backend technologies
* Git/GitHub and deployment
* API integration
* Website optimization
* AI\-assisted development tools
* Professional software development workflows

Candidate Profile

Suitable for **B.Tech/BCA/MCA/B.Sc. Computer Science/IT students, freshers, or candidates with relevant practical skills** who are interested in building a career in web development.

Job Type

**Web Developer Intern**

Experience

**Freshers / 0–1 year experience**

Duration

**Internship – 6 months**, depending on the project and performance.

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Graphic Designer - Architectural
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**

Company Name: Clear Bracket
Seniority level: Associate level

JobType: full\-time



**Location:** South Delhi


* **Experience:** 1 to 3 years
* **Work Mode:** Work from Office
* **Work Structure:** Five Days Working
* **Preferred Background:** B.Arch or Architecture or Spatial Design or Communication Design


**About the Role**

We are hiring a **Communication Designer** for a leading design\-led architecture practice.  

This role sits at the intersection of **architecture, storytelling, visual communication, and brand consistency**.  

The studio’s work needs to be communicated to different audiences — clients, students, media, design juries, institutions, and collaborators. Each audience reads architecture differently. A client looks for value and trust. A student looks for process. A media platform looks for narrative. A design jury looks for intent, clarity, and rigour.  

That is why this role is best suited for someone who has studied or deeply understands architecture, but may not want to practise core architecture.  



**Why an Architecture Background Helps**  

This is not a typical graphic design role.  

  

You will work with:


* plans, sections, drawings, diagrams, renders, photographs, and project notes
* Architectural concepts, material stories, context, process, and spatial intent
* Project decks, award entries, website features, presentations, and design narratives
  


 To do this well, you need to understand what architects are trying to say before turning it into clear visual communication.  

A B.Arch background is valuable because the role requires someone who can read design intent, not just arrange text and images.


**What You Will Do**


* Create visual communication assets for presentations, website, social media, print, events, and digital platforms
* Support project features, award entries, pitch decks, and design presentations
* Translate architectural ideas into clear visual formats
* Work with principals and design teams to understand project intent
* Develop layouts using strong grid, typography, image treatment, and hierarchy
* Help maintain consistency across the studio’s communication material
* Support communication for talks, school presentations, project launches, and media features
* Work with drawings, renders, site images, process notes, and project stories


**What We Are Looking For**  

You may be a strong fit if you:


* Have a B.Arch or architecture / spatial design background
* Enjoy communication more than conventional architectural practice
* Can understand architectural drawings and design process
* Have strong visual layout and typography sense
* Are comfortable working with both images and text
* Are detail\-oriented and patient with refinement
* Can take feedback from senior design leaders
* Are curious about how architecture is made, presented, and remembered


**Skills Required**


* Visual Communication
* Layout Design
* Typography
* Image Editing
* Presentation Design
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe InDesign
* Adobe Photoshop
* AutoCAD
* SketchUp
* Microsoft Office


**Good to Have**


* Writing ability
* Architectural journalism interest
* Award entry experience
* Social media content experience
* Videography / editing skills
* Basic motion graphics
* Familiarity with architectural publications or design media


We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor
description:
**About the Role**

BuildMyInfra is looking for a creative **Graphic Designer \& Video Reel Editor** to create engaging social media creatives, marketing materials, presentations, and short\-form videos.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design **social media posts, banners, brochures, presentations, and marketing creatives**.
* Create and edit **Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn videos, and promotional videos**.
* Add transitions, subtitles, animations, motion graphics, music, and visual effects.
* Maintain brand consistency across all creative content.
* Collaborate with the Marketing \& Content team on creative campaigns.
* Manage multiple projects and deliver work within deadlines.

**Required Skills**

* **Adobe Photoshop \& Illustrator**
* **Adobe Premiere Pro \& After Effects**
* **Canva**
* Video Editing \& Motion Graphics
* Typography \& Color Theory
* Social Media Content Creation
* Visual Storytelling

**Good to have:** Figma, CapCut, basic photography/videography, AI design tools.

Qualification \& Experience

* Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Graphic Design, Multimedia, Fine Arts, or a related field.
* **2–4 years of relevant experience** in Graphic Design and Video Editing.
* Strong portfolio showcasing graphic designs and **5–10 short\-form video reels** is mandatory.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive Salary
* Performance\-Based Incentives
* Career Growth Opportunities
* Learning \& Development
* Creative Work Environment

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
